key.isekai_mahou.afterlife_give_up: Give up returning to your body (hold)
Return to your body before the Reapers catch you
title.isekai_mahou.afterlife.charred.sub: Your items stayed with your remains
hud.isekai_mahou.afterlife.title: On the Brink of Death — %s s
hud.isekai_mahou.afterlife.beat_hint: Press [%s] or click when the pulse crosses the middle
message.isekai_mahou.afterlife.protected: %s's body is still protected (%s min). Only the owner and their party can open it.
message.isekai_mahou.afterlife.spent: Your soul has returned to the body once. Until the next dawn, dying again is for real.
message.isekai_mahou.afterlife.ready: ☀ New day: your soul can return to the body again.
isekai_mahou.configuration.soulOncePerLi: Soul: once per life or per day
After returning to the body, the next death is real until the day turns. A real death gives the chance back. Off: only the interval in seconds applies.
message.isekai_mahou.afterlife.strugglin: %s's soul is struggling to return to the body…
commands.isekai_mahou.afterlife.test: On the Brink of Death: challenge started (test).
commands.isekai_mahou.afterlife.test_fai: Could not start (already a spirit or dead).
commands.isekai_mahou.afterlife.why.surv: you did not die (creative, dodge or a protection stopped the hit)
commands.isekai_mahou.afterlife.why.busy: not possible (already a soul or dead)
commands.isekai_mahou.afterlife.why.spir: true death: died while a soul
commands.isekai_mahou.afterlife.why.keep: normal death: the keepInventory gamerule is on
commands.isekai_mahou.afterlife.why.fire: true death: Charred (fire, lava or Burning)
commands.isekai_mahou.afterlife.why.disa: true death: Near Death is turned off in the config
commands.isekai_mahou.afterlife.why.stuc: true death: stuck in a wall or outside the world border
commands.isekai_mahou.afterlife.why.cool: true death: the soul had already returned to the body in this life (works once per life or per Minecraft day)
commands.isekai_mahou.afterlife.why.over: true death: hit above the overkillLimit config
commands.isekai_mahou.afterlife.why.no_c: true death: the corpse could not be created there
commands.isekai_mahou.afterlife.why.erro: true death: error starting the challenge (see the server log)
isekai_mahou.configuration.afterlife.too: Options for the return-to-body challenge and the Corpses that keep your items.
isekai_mahou.configuration.nearDeathEnab: Dying becomes a challenge to return to your body (except by fire, void or suffocation).
isekai_mahou.configuration.overkillLimit: Damage beyond your health (in max-health units) that kills outright, with no challenge. 0 = no limit.
isekai_mahou.configuration.killCommandNe: /kill also triggers Near Death; a second /kill, as a soul, kills for real.
isekai_mahou.configuration.challengeSeco: Seconds to return to your body.
isekai_mahou.configuration.heartbeatsReq: Heartbeats in rhythm, inside the body, needed to revive.
isekai_mahou.configuration.reaperCount.t: How many Reapers hunt the soul during the challenge.
Fraction of max health when you return to your body.
isekai_mahou.configuration.nearDeathCool: Only with "Soul: once per life or per day" off: after returning, for how many seconds a new death is a real death.
On real death your items stay in a Corpse on the spot. Off: they drop on the ground.
isekai_mahou.configuration.corpseLootPro: Minutes during which only the owner and their party can open the Corpse. 0 = anyone.
